Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

title: Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR)
description:
Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR)

3 days ago – Be among the first 25 applicants.

Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for a Business Development Representative!

Note To Applicants

  • Eligibility This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

About The Role

We are looking for a motivated and ambitious Business Development Representative (BDR/SDR) to drive our next stage of growth. In this role, you’ll work directly with leadership, prospecting and creating opportunities with founders, CEOs, and scaling SMEs. You’ll often be the first voice prospects hear, so clear, confident, and energetic communication is essential. This isn’t just a lead‑generation role—it’s a launchpad. You’ll gain hands‑on experience in full‑cycle sales, from prospecting to closing, and have a clear path to grow into an Account Executive or even a Head of Sales role as the company scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute multi‑channel outbound prospecting (email, LinkedIn, cold calls) to targeted founders, executives, and VC partners.
  • Identify and nurture high‑potential prospects that align with our ICP (early‑stage and scaling SMEs).
  • Conduct initial prospect evaluations (funding stage, headcount, people challenges) before booking meetings.
  • Generate qualified meetings for leadership, ensuring a healthy pipeline and consistent deal flow.
  • Leverage tools like PitchBook, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and HubSpot to research and build prospect lists.
  • Communicate our value proposition with clarity and impact across all outreach.
  • Track, update, and manage activity in HubSpot, ensuring smooth handovers and accurate reporting.
  • Continuously test and optimize outreach cadences, messaging, and conversion tactics.

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in outbound sales, BDR/SDR, or business development.
  • Familiarity with the US startup/SME market and experience collaborating with international teams remotely.
  • Confident and engaging on the phone, articulate over email, and persistent without being pushy.
  • Self‑starter who thrives in fast‑paced, high‑growth environments.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously.

Growth Path

  • Full‑cycle sales: from prospecting → discovery → proposal → close.
  • Strategic selling: engaging with CEOs, founders, and investors.
  • Personal brand building: leveraging LinkedIn and content to open doors.
  • Career development: progression into Account Executive within 12–18 months, with potential to grow into sales leadership as the team expands.

Why Join Us?

  • Base salary: USD $1,500/month.
  • Full‑time, remote role (EST hours).
  • Tools: HubSpot, PitchBook, Sales Navigator, ClickUp, Google Suite.
  • Work directly with leadership in a dynamic, founder‑led team.
  • Be part of a scrappy, high‑growth environment where your impact is immediate.
  • Build the foundation for a long‑term career in sales leadership within the VC/startup ecosystem.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume!

>Associate

Employment type

Full‑time

Job function

Business Consulting and Services

Hard Disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative experience.

Darkroom demands high performance, creativity, and ownership. Remote‑first culture with flexibility; hybrid option for New York or Lisbon hubs starting early 2026. We offer extensive parental leave, ongoing learning across disciplines, and a culture of autonomy with accountability.

Hospital Municipal Pedro II

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

À infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

A unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

title: Ad Tech Developer – Header Bidding (Remote)
description:
At MonetizeMore, we’re all about using data to transform how the advertising industry tackles IVT (Invalid Traffic) and fraud prevention. Our products deliver real impact—and we need top-tier talent to help sell this premium AI product to better protect ad monetized publishers and ad tech vendors.

For 15 years, we’ve been driven by a team of 100+ talented professionals across the globe. As a 100% remote and culture-centric organization, we are built on the core pillars of Integrity, Collaboration, Enterprising, and Kaizen, ensuring excellence in everything we do.

About the Role

MonetizeMore is seeking an Ad Tech Developer with in-depth expertise in header bidding to build, optimize, and scale programmatic monetization for premium publishers. You’ll own end-to-end header bidding implementations (with a heavy focus on Prebid.js), improve auction performance, and partner with product, yield, and publisher success teams to deliver revenue-lifting results with excellent user experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Design & implement header bidding stacks using Prebid.js (web) and related wrappers; configure bidders, floors, price granularity, userId modules, and analytics.
  • Customize & extend adapters/modules (e.g., userId, analytics, consent) and contribute clean, documented JavaScript/TypeScript code.
  • Integrate with GAM/Ad Manager (GPT): line item strategy, key-values, creative templates, and troubleshooting of delivery and competition.
  • Optimize auctions & latency: tune timeouts, s2s vs. client, floors, ad refresh logic, and page performance (CLS/LCP/INP/Core Web Vitals).
  • Run experiments: A/B test bidders, formats, and page placements; build dashboards to track impact (e.g., eCPM, viewability, fill, latency).
  • Debug complex issues across browser, network, and auction layers (DevTools, HAR/Waterfall, Charles/Proxyman); resolve revenue dips & bidder errors.
  • Implement privacy & compliance: IAB TCF, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA, CMP integration, consent storage, and geo-specific behaviors.
  • Work with partners: SSPs, exchanges, ID providers, and analytics vendors to launch new demand and troubleshoot.
  • Ship quality safely: use Git, CI/CD, code review, and observability to keep releases fast and reliable.
  • Document & mentor: write clear runbooks and help level up teammates.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–6+ years of front-end or full-stack experience with a strong JavaScript foundation (TypeScript a plus).
  • 2–4+ years hands-on with header bidding (Prebid.js required); experience with s2s/managed wrappers (e.g., Prebid Server, Amazon TAM/UAM) is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of Google Ad Manager (GAM/GPT) setups, line items & creatives, key-values, targeting, and delivery debugging.
  • Working knowledge of programmatic concepts: OpenRTB, floors, auction dynamics, user sync/ID, brand safety, and viewability.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks & CMPs (IAB TCF v2.x, GDPR/CCPA/CPRA) and consent-aware ad serving.
  • Performance tuning for Core Web Vitals and modern build tools (Webpack/Vite/Rollup).
  • Comfort with Chrome DevTools, network waterfalls, and log-driven debugging; bonus points for Node.js, Cloud Functions, or simple backend endpoints.
  • Data fluency: basic SQL or BI tools (Looker/Data Studio/BigQuery) for revenue & latency analysis.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; bias for automation and measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with app/webview monetization, AMP, or SPA frameworks (React/Vue/Svelte).
  • Prebid analytics adapters or custom reporting pipelines.
  • Experience with ads.txt/app-ads.txt, sellers.json, supply chain object.
  • Knowledge of brand safety & IVT controls, creative QA, and MRC viewability standards.
  • Exposure to video (IMA/OMSDK, Prebid Video, VAST/VPAID/VMAP) or CTV/OTT.
  • Knowledge in Python and NoSQL is a plus.

Why MonetizeMore

  • Remote-first culture with flexible work hours.
  • Impact at scale across a large publisher network.
  • Smart, low-ego teammates and a culture of experimentation.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, home-office stipend, and learning budget.

The OT Cybersecurity Technical Architect is responsible for designing and implementing the technical components of the organization's cybersecurity strategy. This role involves creating secure systems and network architectures, selecting and configuring security technologies, and collaborating with cross‑functional teams to ensure the organization's digital assets are adequately protected.

  • Develop and implement OT cybersecurity architectures tailored for renewable energy production and operations.

2 days ago – Be among the first 25 applicants.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting‑edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7 million hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees represent 95+ nationalities across 27 markets, fostering a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

Our Purpose – Bridging the World Through Travel

We believe travel allows people to enjoy, learn, and experience more of the amazing world we live in. It brings individuals and cultures closer together, fostering empathy, understanding, and happiness. We are a skillful, driven, and diverse team united by a passion to make an impact, harnessing innovative technologies and strong partnerships to make travel easy and rewarding for everyone.

Get to Know our Team

In Agoda’s Engineering department we build scalable and fault‑tolerant systems covering all major business areas: website, mobile apps, affiliate APIs, inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, finance and more. These mission‑critical systems change frequently, with dozens of releases per day. To keep everything running smoothly we employ state‑of‑the‑art CI/CD, experimentation and advanced testing techniques, ensuring everything works without any downtime. Our stack includes React, Redux, JavaScript, Kotlin, Scala, Kafka, Aerospike, and big‑data technologies, all supported by agile development practices.

Opportunity

The Senior Engineering Manager role is one of the most significant and challenging roles in Technology. The right candidate has deep technical knowledge and exhibits extremely strong leadership and people‑development skills, with experience leading large engineering teams and managing managers.

In this Role, you’ll get to

  • Manage large engineering teams.
  • Directly manage engineering managers and star engineers.
  • Provide technical input into new business ideas.
  • Work with senior leadership up to C‑level.
  • Work and drive initiatives outside of your core team.
  • Build and guide the technical roadmap for your area.
  • Take ownership of major projects that are strategic to Agoda.
  • Love engineering and build things elegantly at scale, keeping up with industry trends.
  • Develop people: inspiring those around you to reach their potential and integrating top talent into the business.

What you’ll Need to Succeed

  • Experience managing large engineering teams (>25 people).
  • Experience hiring and managing engineering managers.
  • Experience developing future engineering managers from within the company.
  • Experience rapidly growing a team.
  • Experience communicating to C‑level.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing engineering teams and 10+ years in software engineering.
  • Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility.
  • Able to operate autonomously, making decisions, setting KPIs, and owning outcomes.
  • Extremely proficient in at least one programming language (React, JavaScript, Kotlin, Scala, Java, C#).
  • Knowledge of scale, microservices, and clean architecture.
  • Focus on velocity and quality, with the right engineering metrics to guide and improve.
  • Excellent people‑management and communication skills.
  • Minimum a B.S. in Computer Science or a quantitative field.

It’s great if you have many of these

  • Proficiency in a range of backend programming languages.
  • Experience in data engineering and working with Big Data.
  • Experience managing in a data‑driven company with large user and transaction volumes.
  • Experience at an Internet company at scale with global projects serving worldwide markets.
  • Experience in FinTech / Financial systems.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.

We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies, and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.

Disclaimer

At Amazon, we are committed to being the safest place to work in the world, the best employer, and the most customer‑centric company. Key Job Responsibilities

In this position, you will be responsible for the entire PXT (People eXperience and Technology - Human Resources) agenda in an Amazon warehouse located in Cabo de Santo Agostinho - PE. The generalist role in HR will involve staffing and workforce management in different hiring formats, internal communication and employee engagement, leadership development at supervisor to managerial levels, general coordination of labor and employee relations issues, consolidation and reporting of metrics (absenteeism, attrition, fill rates), indirect coordination of shuttle transportation and restaurant, continuous improvement plans for employee experience, Diversity and Inclusion programs, among others.

A Day in the Life

  • Work with a team of HR Assistants to create the best experience for employees.
  • Lead the reporting and analysis of HR metrics and goals.
  • Participate in "Daily Dive Deep – DDD" meetings along with the Operations team and other support areas.
  • Co‑lead workforce planning meetings, execution of staffing and terminations.
  • Conduct "Gemba" and monitor operational processes in the "shop‑floor".
  • Monitor the environment from a labor and employee relations perspective, identifying trends and risks.
  • Participate in Brazil PXT Operations team meetings, reporting metrics and indicators of your operation.
  • Lead PXT and multidisciplinary projects that go beyond your work unit.
  • Promote and model an inclusive environment for all employees through specific programs, local initiatives, and affinity groups.
  • Support employee inquiries and situations with discretion and experience, along with routine standard work on employee onboarding, performance management, engagement processes, and benefits services.
  • Train, develop, and support leadership through decision‑making.
  • Collaborate with various levels of the organization, from frontline employees to senior leaders.
  • Influence and guide partners to prioritize employee experience and customer obsession.

About the Team

  • Are excited to work in a fast‑paced and team‑oriented environment.
  • Are enthusiastic about working in a production environment (logistics warehouse) engaging our teams, training our leaders, and creating the best place in the world to work.
  • Are excited about generalist positions where each day you will deal with various Human Resources topics.
  • Are enthusiastic about flexing your routine when necessary, making room to occasionally work night shifts or weekends, in an operation that runs 24/7 every day of the year.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of HR work within an international, fast‑paced, and customer‑driven environment experience
  • Knowledge of local labor law
  • Experience in HR within an international, fast‑paced and customer‑driven environment
  • Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment
  • Experience supporting hourly employee client group
  • Experience with MS Office tools and HR Information Systems
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Human Resources Management
  • Experience in human resources with companies supporting 250-500 or more associates
  • Experience managing and leading employees

title: Engenheiro de Operações de Embarcações
description:
Engenheiro de Operações de Embarcações – PRIO – Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

PRIO is Brazil’s largest independent oil and gas company. We continuously seek process optimization and innovative solutions to reduce costs. All work is multidisciplinary and each challenge is unique.

We are looking for an Engenheiro de Operações de Embarcações to ensure availability, reliability, and compliance of vessels under your management, orchestrating personnel, suppliers, and processes to plan, execute, and continuously improve maintenance and asset performance. You will manage critical component modifications, align CAPEX/OPEX, operational schedules, and regulatory requirements (ANP, IBAMA, NR/ABNT, Class), sustaining company strategy and delivering subsea projects with performance in cost and Utilization Rate (Taxa de Utilização ).

Responsabilidades

  • Participar das discussões técnicas com o gestor da embarcação, de modo a auxiliar nas tomadas de decisões de manutenção, principalmente, nas que envolverem reparo e retorno;
  • Gerir junto ao gestor da embarcação as operações da unidade com foco na segurança e na disponibilidade operacional (uptime) do ativo através do planejamento estruturado;
  • Conduz os projetos e manutenções de alto impacto financeiro (CAPEX/OPEX) assegurando o cumprimento de escopo, prazos e qualidade pré definidos;
  • Atuar como interface com o time Subsea para converter a embarcação ao modo operacional requerido pelo projeto sempre que for pelo cliente, garantindo integrações técnicas seguras e eficazes;
  • Garantir junto ao gestor da embarcação que o planejamento financeiro de 5 anos seja mantido sempre atualizado (CAPEX e OPEX) sob gestão diligente de custos e escopo, garantindo visibilidade de viabilidade do ativo a longo prazo;
  • Realizar a Gestão mensal de custo da unidade com visibilidade de tendência (OPEX /CAPEX);
  • Acompanhar os serviços de terceirizadas garantindo eficiência e redução de custos necessários para operação da embarcação, bem como aprovar os Boletim de Medição referentes a serviços de bordo, mediante avaliação técnica do serviço entregues no ativo;
  • Acompanhar as auditorias, monitorar e garantir a execução dos planos de ação de não conformidades regulamentadas por agências governamentais (ANP, Ibama, Anvisa, etc), em especial dentro dos regulamentos de SGSO, SGSS, Medição Fiscal, CONAMA 393, Port State, órgão de classe e Normas Regulamentadoras;
  • Conduzir e orientar os registros das mudanças e adequações operacionais, sendo o facilitador do processo de Gestão de Mudança (MoC);
  • Identificar melhorias e revisar os procedimentos operacionais do ativo;
  • Avaliar e aprovar requisições e ordens de compra e interagir com Supply na contratação e tomada de decisão referente a fornecedores de serviços, equipamentos e materiais;
  • Gerir indicadores de performance do ativo (disponibilidade, confiabilidade, custos, prazo), promovendo ações corretivas quando necessário;
  • Conduzir reuniões periódicas com os envolvidos (suportes) para alinhar o planejamento e monitorar os avanços e serviços contratados;
  • Garantir adequado gerenciamento do ciclo de manutenção no ERP do ativo (planos, job cards, backlog, repostos críticos), garantindo execução on-time e atualização de históricos;
  • Liderar investigações de falhas (FRE/RCA), eliminar reincidências e retroalimentar planos de manutenção e procedimentos;
  • Definir critérios técnicos “compráveis” (especificações, HF codes, listas de materiais) e gerir riscos de obsolescência e intercambialidade;
  • Planejar janelas de porto (port calls) e gerenciar recursos necessários para rotina da embarcação junto ao cliente;
  • Gerir contratos e desempenho de fornecedores estratégicos (SLAs/KTIs), realizando expedições técnicas, auditorias e aplicação de lições aprendidas;
  • Desenvolver e monitorar KPIs (MTBF, MTTR, OTIF de manutenção, lead time de aquisição, disponibilidade do guindaste/sistemas), com dashboards e rotinas de performance operacional, de segurança e de manutenção;
  • Conduzir comunicação executiva (status, riscos, decisões de go/no-go), escalar bloqueios e alinhar prioridades com Operações/Subsea/Financeiro;
  • Garantir que a gestora da embarcação capacite toda a tripulação e equipes de apoio em treinamentos técnicos, procedimentos críticos, lições aprendidas;
  • Garantir que a gestora da embarcação planeje o estoque de sobressalentes críticos (níveis mínimos, cobertura, análise ABC) eliminando paradas por falta de materiais;
  • Responder a eventos críticos (falhas severas, incidentes), coordenar contingências e restabelecer a operação com segurança e celeridade;
  • Garantir aderência a políticas internas (alçadas, compliance, integridade, ESG) e participar de fóruns de governança de manutenção e projetos.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Curso superior em Engenharia ou certificação de Chefe de Máquinas;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de embarcações de médio porte como PLSV e MPSV;
  • Experiência em gestão de manutenção com foco em confiabilidade, gestão de custo e geração de KPI’s;
  • Experiência em gestão de guindastes offshore com sistema compensador de heave;
  • Experiência em análise de falhas baseado em metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de melhoria contínua.

Processo Seletivo

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO? Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, a sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Benefícios e Ambiente

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time.

title: Ad Demand Partnerships Manager (Remote)
description:
MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, helping publishers maximize revenue by building strong, transparent, and diversified demand partnerships. We work with leading DSPs, SSPs, ad networks, and agencies worldwide to create a more competitive auction environment that drives higher fill rates and stronger returns for publishers across web, app, and CTV. This role is central to that mission: scaling and optimizing our global demand stack, forging strategic relationships with top programmatic buyers, and ensuring sustainable, diversified revenue growth.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Manager of Ad Demand Partnerships to dramatically expand and nurture and optimize our programmatic demand partnerships stack. This is a critical, revenue-generating role focused on forging new strategic relationships with global and niche Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), Supply Side Platforms (SSPs), Ad Networks, and other premium demand partner sources.

Your success will be measured by your ability to increase competition within our ad stack, resulting in higher fill rates and Session RPMs/CPMs for our publishers' inventory across all platforms (web, app, and CTV).

Key Responsibilities

Demand Acquisition & Financial Strategy

  • New Partner Sourcing: Proactively identify, prioritize, negotiate, and close new demand partnership agreements with top-tier global and regional advertising platforms (DSPs, Ad Networks, Media Agencies, Trading Desks).
  • Contract Negotiation: Strategically negotiate solid revenue share models and favorable payment terms with demand partners, ad networks that mutually benefit both MonetizeMore and our Publishers.
  • Key Account Focus: Establish and maintain high-level relationships with major programmatic buyers, including companies like The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Amazon, Criteo, and similar companies.
  • Revenue Diversification: Optimize the auction bid pressure from non-Google demand partners to diversify revenue sources for MonetizeMore publishers. Increase the Share of Voice (SOV) from revenue originating from Non-Google Demand to improve our overall revenue diversification.
  • Inventory Expansion: Seek opportunities to add value to our publishers' inventory by targeting local ad agencies that may be interested in buying direct inventory or PMP deals.
  • Media Kit Development: Create a professional solid media kit and compelling pitch materials that will entice demand partners, ad networks, and agencies to buy our inventory.

Technical Integration & Operational Oversight

  • Header Bidding Expertise: Initiate and lead the technical and business integration of new demand partners via MonetizeMore’s proprietary Header Bidding wrapper, ensuring seamless and low-latency performance.
  • Platform Diversification: Drive monetization growth across emerging channels, including Connected TV (CTV), Mobile App Monetization, and other high-growth video environments.
  • Financial Flow Ownership: Take ownership of the payment pipeline and work closely with the Finance Team to ensure demand partner payments are received on time and continue to avoid issues paying our publisher payments are always received on time.
  • Integration Process Management: Work closely with our Ad Ops and Engineering teams to manage the technical onboarding lifecycle process, including seamless communication between ad ops and demand partner setup on new publishers, from initial testing to full launch and optimization.

Communication & Reporting

  • High-Impact Communication: Clearly and effectively communicate complex technical and business terms to both internal teams and external executive partners.
  • Documentation & Training: Break down complex demand integration processes into simple, clear chunks for internal training and documentation.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay ahead of industry trends (privacy changes, identity solutions, supply path optimization, etc.) and translate their impact into actionable demand strategies.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 3+ years of successful experience in a Demand Partnerships, Business Development, or Supply/Monetization role within the Ad Tech or Publisher space.
  • Industry Knowledge: Solid, expert-level understanding of the programmatic ecosystem, including Header Bidding (Prebid), SSPs, DSPs, and Ad Exchanges.
  • Strategic Negotiator: Proven ability to negotiate and manage commercial contracts, specifically focusing on revenue share and net payment terms.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong understanding of ad demand integration processes, including VAST/VPAID for video, SDKs for app monetization, and general ad serving logic.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to solve problems, initiate partnerships via cold outreach, negotiate and present to senior leaders and executive-level contacts.
  • Organization: Highly organized, detail-oriented, and adept at managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

Bonus Qualifications (A Major Plus)

  • Deep DSP Network: Existing contacts and relationships with key decision-makers at The Trade Desk or other major DSPs and SSPs/Trading Desks.
  • Trade Desk Experience: Previous employment experience at The Trade Desk or a similar Tier-1 DSP.
  • Global Focus: Experience managing demand partners and monetization across diverse international markets (EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page.

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients’ experience. It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank’s efficiency. We are looking for people who are independent and who are not afraid to take the initiative to identify and solve problems that are not necessarily obvious. You can read more about it in our blog and get some insights into how we work.

As a Business Analyst, You’re Expected To

  • Do a lot of investigative work, focused on deciding which data makes the most sense to use in which situation. If you don’t have the data, it’s your job to think about what tests can be done or how to extract the information you need to answer your questions;
  • Support your team in making data‑based decisions by monitoring analysis and decisions, ensuring the flow of projects and making the process of taking risks comfortable despite the uncertainties;
  • Learn how to work with a large volume of data to build a solid foundation for decision making with calculated risks - even knowing that not all the answers are in the data and/or that not all the data you would like is available; Use tools like SQL, Python and Scala - taught during your first weeks with us - for data extraction;
  • Understand our products and interactions with other areas;
  • Take advantage of opportunities to grow and learn from a well‑prepared and highly qualified team;
  • Opportunity to work in a complex, dynamic and diverse environment, participating in projects that will impact a large number of clients.

What are we looking for?

  • Analytical capacity: ease with numbers and calculations, having the ability to solve problems mathematically;
  • Business basics: dynamics between risks and opportunities, as well as interaction between business areas and technical areas (products/engineering);
  • Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day‑to‑day challenges and achieve the best results;
  • Ability to understand how your decisions and work impact our customers’ experience, seeking results that align with our purpose;
  • Willingness and ease of learning, especially for tools;
  • Openness to receive feedback and incorporate it into your daily life and development;
  • Adaptability to the multifunctional environment;
  • Profiles that add value to Nubank’s culture.

Our Benefits

  • Chance of earning equity at Nubank
  • Food/ Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação)
  • Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte)
  • NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program

Industries & Environment - Possibilitando infraestrutura, transporte e indústrias mais seguras, sustentáveis e ecológicas. Na SGS, fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços integrados de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas ajuda a indústria a navegar por uma ampla gama de novos padrões, regulamentos e responsabilidades corporativas.

Health & Nutrition – Trabalhamos para ampliar a segurança, qualidade e sustentabilidade dos produtos alimentares, de saúde e bem-estar. Os clientes precisam saber que os alimentos que ingerem, os medicamentos, os produtos cosméticos e de higiene que utilizam são seguros e não os prejudicam. Na SGS, oferecemos a mais ampla gama de soluções de teste, inspeção e certificação para as indústrias de ciência agrícola, alimentos, ciências da saúde e cosméticos

Natural Resources – Possibilitando eficiência e sustentabilidade nas indústrias agrícola, de mineração, petróleo, gás e química. Os recursos naturais são essenciais para o desenvolvimento econômico e fundamentais para a vida cotidiana. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte com terceirização de laboratório, logística de commodities, geoquímica, metalurgia, sustentabilidade e soluções de inteligência de mercado para ajudar

a reduzir riscos, tomar decisões informadas e garantir a integridade.

Connectivity & Products – Possibilitando produtos e serviços melhores e mais seguros. À medida que o mundo se torna mais conectado, marcas, fabricantes, varejistas e governos devem garantir a segurança, a qualidade e a conformidade regulatória de seus produtos e serviços. Fornecemos a gama mais abrangente do mundo de serviços de inspeção, teste, certificação e consultoria, com tecnologia de ponta e ferramentas digitais. Nossa rede global de especialistas oferece suporte em todas as etapas – desde o projeto, produção e conformidade regulamentar até a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

A Resilion é a primeira plataforma brasileira de inteligência climática e operacional para o setor de energia, que está redefinindo a resiliência da rede elétrica por meio de monitoramento avançado, análises preditivas e excelência em serviços.

Combinamos sensoriamento inteligente (hardware) e insights gerados por IA (software) para ajudar concessionárias e operadores de infraestrutura a aprimorar a confiabilidade e o desempenho de seus ativos com soluções tecnológicas escaláveis.

Visão Geral da Posição

O Líder de Estratégia de Operações e Soluções será responsável por desenhar e executar a estratégia operacional e de implantação ponta a ponta da Resilion em todo o setor de infraestrutura energética do Brasil.

Suas responsabilidades incluirão definir a estratégia de hardware e aquisição de dados da empresa, selecionar e gerenciar fornecedores e parceiros técnicos, supervisionar a entrega e instalação dos equipamentos, além de planejar e executar implantações completas junto aos clientes.

Também dará suporte ao Gerente Geral nas atividades comerciais, oferecendo expertise técnica e liderança de solução durante as interações com clientes.

Principais Responsabilidade

Desenho de Soluções & Engenharia de Campo

  • Liderar iniciativas multifuncionais focadas em resiliência de ativos, eficiência operacional e confiabilidade do sistema, integrando soluções de hardware e dados.
  • Projetar e definir a arquitetura da solução, determinando a combinação ideal de sensores, fontes de dados e insumos analíticos (ex.: dispositivos IoT, imagens de satélite, dados meteorológicos).
  • Selecionar, estruturar e gerenciar parceiros-chave de hardware e aquisição de dados, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e interoperabilidade entre as implantações.
  • Supervisionar a instalação, configuração, testes e implantação dos sistemas de monitoramento da Resilion, em coordenação com a área de tecnologia e equipes de fornecedores.
  • Desenvolver e padronizar procedimentos de comissionamento, documentação de campo e materiais de treinamento para garantir execução consistente e de alta qualidade.

Planejamento e Execução Operacional

  • Supervisionar funções operacionais críticas, incluindo gestão de estoque, logística e planejamento da instalação, assegurando implantações eficientes.
  • Liderar o planejamento de CAPEX/OPEX, o alinhamento de compras e a governança de fornecedores, garantindo operações escaláveis e custo‑efetivas.
  • Trabalhar de forma transversal com engenharia, operações e liderança para padronizar processos, aumentar eficiência e escalar entregas.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico de operações, traduzindo aprendizados de campo em prioridades práticas e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

Perfil & Experiência

Requisitos

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica/Mecânica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mais de 7 anos de experiência em operações, engenharia de campo ou entrega de soluções nos setores de energia, telecomunicações ou infraestrutura.
  • Sólido conhecimento técnico em sistemas elétricos de potência ou ambientes industriais de IoT.
  • Experiência em planejamento de CAPEX/OPEX, processos de compras e coordenação de fornecedores.
  • Fluência em português e inglês (preferencial).

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em manutenção preditiva, ciência de dados ou sistemas de monitoramento de desempenho.
  • Vivência em ambiente de startup ou empresa em rápido crescimento, com capacidade de atuar de forma independente, estruturar processos do zero e adaptar‑se rapidamente a prioridades em evolução.

title: Airport Services Officer
description: Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards. Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team. Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to): Operational Leadership Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators. IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business. Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives. Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager. Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards. Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development. Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed. CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager. Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required. Team Development Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start. Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training. Compliance & QHSE Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement. Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements. Commercial Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed. Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents,

title: Junior Project Manager, Service Provisioning
description:
About Dacxi Chain Dacxi Chain is building the critical infrastructure for the future of global capital formation. As the world's first tokenized crowdfunding infrastructure, we're creating the foundational layer that enables entrepreneurs to connect with everyday investors worldwide through blockchain technology. By tokenizing company shares on our infrastructure, we're eliminating traditional barriers like geographical borders and limited liquidity - making capital raising seamless for businesses and investment opportunities accessible to everyone, everywhere. We're not just creating a platform;
we're architecting theessential infrastructure that will power the next generation of crowdfunding - transparent, scalable, and globally accessible. Job Description: Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager We are searching for a highly skilled and strategic Senior Technical Project & Delivery Manager to lead our most critical initiatives. This advanced hybrid role combines the governance of a PMO, the hands-on coordination of a Delivery Manager, and the technical depth of a Project Manager. You will also be entrusted with key Product Owner responsibilities, acting as the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders. Your mission is to ensure projects are not only delivered on time and within budget but also align with our strategic product vision and maintain the highest quality standards. Important: This role is only open to candidates based in Brazil, and requires fluent Portuguese and fluent English. This is a fully remote position, working with teams across Brazil, the UK, and New Zealand. Key Responsibilities: Project Governance & Technical PMO: Develop, refine, and enforce technical project management methodologies and best practices across the organization. Manage and maintain a comprehensive RAID log, proactively identifying and mitigating potential roadblocks. Maintain a decision log to document and track key project decisions, ensuring transparency and accountability. Oversee an action log, holding all team members and stakeholders accountable for their commitments. Implement "Planned vs. Actual" reporting to track project performance against initial baselines, highlighting deviations in scope, schedule, and budget. Delivery & Release Management: Serve as the central point of contact for project coordination, facilitating communication and collaboration between product, development, QA, and Go-to-Market (GTM) teams across different time zones. Partner with QA to ensure testing is integrated seamlessly into the project lifecycle, from early-stage validation to final quality assurance. Coordinate with GTM teams to align on release schedules and ensure a smooth, well-prepared launch of new products or features. Orchestrate and manage the end-to-end release process, ensuring all dependencies are met and risks are mitigated. Hold product and engineering teams accountable for their commitments, ensuring deliverables are met on time and to the required standard. Project & Product Ownership: Lead the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and planning to execution and post-mortem analysis. Act as the Product Owner for specific initiatives, ensuring the development team's work aligns with the overall product roadmap. Translate business and user needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams. Proactively identify and address potential pitfalls, technical debt, and risks to ensure the project stays on track. Provide high-quality, data-driven reporting to leadership and stakeholders, offering transparent insights into project status and performance. Qualifications: Proven experience in a technical project management role, with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). Demonstrated experience with PMO functions, including process standardization, governance, and portfolio management. Must be currently based in Brazil and fluent in both written and verbal Portuguese and English. Expertise in managing project documentation, specifically RAID logs, decision logs, and action logs. A track record of successfully holding cross-functional teams accountable for their deliverables. Experience performing Product Owner duties, such as managing a product backlog and defining user stories. Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of coordinating development, QA, and GTM teams across global locations. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate actionable insights from metrics like "planned vs. actual". Relevant certifications (e.G., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or similar) are highly desirable. Preferred Skills: Innovative Mindset: A forward-thinking approach, staying ahead of industry and technology trends. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven decision-making approach. Stakeholder Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to manage expectations and keep technical and non-technical stakeholders aligned. Execution & Ownership: Strong sense of ownership, with a track record of driving complex projects to completion on time and to quality. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, globally distributed teams. Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, adjusting plans as priorities evolve. This role is for a proactive leader who is passionate about both the big picture and the details. If you're ready to define processes, drive technical delivery, hold teams accountable, and help shape our product vision, we want to hear from you. Interested?If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you! Join us in revolutionizing the global funding landscape at Dacxi Chain.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Serviços de apoio técnico e suporte especializado em atividades laboratoriais para pesquisa aplicada à exploração, produção e refino de petróleo. RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS Registro e controle de custódia de amostras laboratoriais e suas subamostras;
Suportar e realizar a demanda de ensaios de química analítica e correlatos: realizar protocolo de implantação, validação, execução de análises e desenvolvimento de método analítico na área química em Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC), com detectores UV, fluorescência, IR, ELSD e Espectrômetro de Massas (baixa e alta resoluções), Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID), Cromatografia de Camada Fina (TLC-FID), Cromatografias Preparativas e Extrações em Fase Sólida, Cromatografia de Permeação em Gel (GPC), além de qualquer técnica cromatográfica ou técnica analítica instrumental que possa ser necessária para os atendimentos;
Realizar análise de petróleo e derivados como: diesel, nafta, gasóleos e lubrificantes, dentre outras matrizes, avaliar consistência dos dados, emitir laudos de análise, especificar tecnicamente e encaminhar solicitações de compras de equipamentos e insumos em atendimento às exigências da legislação vigente e de forma a garantir a confiabilidade analítica do laboratório;
Preparo e análise dealíquotas de amostras de produtos (material de referência) e padrões de referência, bem como suas análises, para o Controle Estatístico de Processos (CEP) dos serviços de Análises por Cromatografia Líquida – construção de curvas de calibração, validação de equipamentos e métodos analíticos;
Construção, execuçãoe manutenção de ferramentas de controle e garantia da qualidade de resultados analíticos (cartas de controle, curvas de calibração, controle de padrões certificados etc.), bem como quaisquer ações necessárias para viabilizar a gestão da qualidade;
Preparo de amostras (pesagem, centrifugação, precipitação, filtração, extração com solventes, extração em fase sólida e quaisquer outras operações unitárias necessárias para adequação da amostra original ao método analítico instrumental que suportará o atendimento solicitado, não exclusivo a métodos cromatográficos);
Fracionamento e análise de amostras orgânicas por cromatografia líquida (MPLC, HPLC e preparativa/gravimétrica);
Aferição das vidrarias de precisão, no ato do recebimento ou sob demanda específica;
Alimentação debases de dados por uso de softwares de aplicação à laboratórios de análises químicas;
Manutenção básica operacional de Cromatógrafos e outros equipamentos analíticos, configuração básica de hardware e software;
Solicitar e acompanhar manutenção das instalações, equipamentos e fornecimento de consumíveis;
Gestão das amostras no laboratório, incluindo recebimento, aceitação e armazenamento adequado das amostras, cadastro de amostras, solicitação de ensaios, emissão de resultados, devolução de amostras já concluídas no sistema de gerenciamento de informações de laboratório (LIMS) vigente;
Gestão e controle deestoque e orçamentação de insumos (reagentes, padrões etc.), peças e equipamentos laboratoriais;
Coordenação, execução, atualização e confecção de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrões pertinentes às rotinas laboratoriais;
Coordenação e execução de descartes de resíduos laboratoriais;
Zelar, executar e garantir o cumprimento das normas e requisitos de segurança do laboratório e liberação de serviços no local;
Coordenação detreinamentos necessários para capacitação de técnicos na execução das análises e metodologias analíticas por Cromatografia Líquida;
Realizar visitas técnicas externas para acompanhamento e execução de serviços ou incorporação de tecnologias;
Otimização dosrecursos e infraestrutura laboratoriais para produção analítica;
Dominar ferramentas de suporte ao processamento dos dados, compilação e apresentação de resultados, como: MS Office, Chemstation/EZChrom (OpenLab);
Emissão de relatórios e/ou laudos (certificados) de análise em português e/ou Inglês;
Demais atividades necessárias à execução dos serviços acima mencionados. REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS Formação: Graduação Completa em Química. Experiência: Vivência mínima de 6 anos em cromatografia líquida de alta eficiência ou 5 anos de vivência em alguma das técnicas abaixo: 1.Cromatografia Líquida de Alta Eficiência (HPLC);
2.Cromatografia em Fluido Supercrítico (SFC-FID);
3.Cromatografia em Camada Fina (TLC-FID);
4.Cromatografia de Permeação em Gel (GPC). Domínio do Pacote Office;

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação  Ferramentas de visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik etc);  Ferramentas de análise de dados (SAS, Knime, etc.);  Data Mining;  Data Modeling;  Project Management;  Metodologias desenvolvimento lean/agile;  Obrigatório Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia de Produção, Estatística, e áreas afins.

title: Chef

Nossos menus são criados com criatividade e paixão, e nosso serviço é oferecido com atenção e elegância. Liderar e treinar a equipe da cozinha, garantindo cumprimento dos procedimentos internos, segurança de alimentos e uso adequado de EPIs.  Gerir estoque de insumos, materiais e equipamentos, acompanhando validade, conservação, manutenção e realizando previsões de compras e reposições.  Supervisionar todas as etapas da produção de alimentos, assegurando qualidade, higiene e excelência no serviço.  Conduzir entrevistas técnicas, avaliações de desempenho e fornecer feedback contínuo, reconhecendo boas performances e promovendo motivação e espírito de equipe.  Planejar e aplicar treinamentos técnicos, além de participar dos cursos de Segurança de Alimentos.  Zelar pela segurança, assim como pelo correto tratamento e descarte de resíduos.  Requisitos:  Experiência mínima de 7+ anos em hotelaria 5★  all day dining .  Expertise em cozinha Mediterrânea e Brasileira com visão de gastronomia de luxo.  Experiência sólida com  multi-outlets  (restaurante, room service e piscina).  Capacidade de entrega em grandes volumes, com excelência.  Vivência com padrões LQA ( Leading Quality Assurance ).  Gestão de equipes acima de 40 colaboradores.  Domínio de protocolos HACCP.  Inglês prático, será um diferencial.  Benefícios  Plano de Saúde e Odontológico extensivo a dependentes diretos.  Convênio Farmácia.  Vale transporte.  Alimentação no local.  Seguro de Vida  Folga de Aniversário  Descontos nos pontos de vendas da empresa.  De acordo com o seu “tempo de casa”, você adquiri diárias e experiências gratuitas nas propriedades da empresa ao redor do mundo, incluindo 50% de desconto em Alimentos & Bebidas.  Nos esforçamos para criar um ambiente onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) possam prosperar tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente. Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.  Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje! Sobre nós  Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.  Inicie sua jornada profissional no mundo da hospitalidade no ícone brasileiro à beira-mar com mais de um século de história. description: Quem somos  O Grupo Rocie tem como propósito oferecer produtos de qualidade com preços acessíveis, sempre atentos às tendências mundiais para disponibilizar o que há de melhor no mercado. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Closer b2b - outbound

title: Network security specialist, enterprise browser
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We AreThis role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your CareerYou will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.
Your ImpactWin new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and account strategies to increase our sales penetration of Enterprise Browser into our top accounts
Engage with customers to identify and progress opportunities whilst delivering subject matter expertise on Enterprise Browser solutions
Qualify and progress leads and opportunities through the sales cycle to closure
Keep up-to-date knowledge of Enterprise Browser and other browser technologies as well as the competitive position of the company
Conduct consistent training and communications for the sales and channel teams as well as joint engagement within the wider organization
Contribute to the larger Palo Alto Network’s Prisma SASE strategy by providing regional specific intelligence and reporting
Apply subject matter expertise in training, QBRs, enablement, and other engagement activities
Gather “Voice of Customer” and competitive intelligence and share with theater and global Prisma SASE organization
Help build and project Palo Alto Networks positionQualifications
Your Experience4+ years' experience exceeding sales quota as Account Manager, or Territory Account Manager for a multinational company
Sales excellence - ability to demonstrate planning, strategy, qualification and execution
Prior experience selling SAAS or Cybersecurity network solutions
Existing relationships within the region, including top accounts and reseller partners
Excellent communication skills including strong verbal and written skills and proven presentation skills being able to articulate complex topics
Experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniquesAdditional Information
The TeamPalo Alto Networks has brought technology to the market that is reshaping the cybersecurity threat and protection landscape. Our ability to protect digital transactions is limited only by our ability to establish relationships with our potential customers and help them understand how our products can protect their environments. This is where our sales teams come in. Our sales team members work together with large organizations to keep their digital information safe. Our passionate sales teams educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients.
As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are driven by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats. You’re an amazing salesperson – you’re just looking for something more substantial and challenging as your next step.
Our CommitmentWe’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus. Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

Em nossa clínica, transformamos vidas através de uma odontologia de excelência. Nossos valores fundamentais de honestidade, comprometimento, dedicação e qualidade guiam cada atendimento e procedimento que realizamos. Somos movidos pela missão de proporcionar saúde bucal de forma ética, humana e responsável, criando experiências únicas para nossos pacientes.

• Experiência comprovada em clínicas odontológicas ou médicas • Residir OBRIGATORIAMENTE a no máximo 8 km da clínica (exemplo nos bairros: Realengo, Bangu, Campo Grande, Santa Cruz, Sepetiba ou Itaguaí) • Disponibilidade para início imediato

• Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita • Organização e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas • Proatividade e resolução eficiente de problemas • Discrição e comprometimento com a confidencialidade • Habilidade com sistemas informatizados e pacote Office • Sorriso genuíno e capacidade de acolher pacientes mesmo em momentos de ansiedade
POR QUE SE JUNTAR A NÓ S?
• Propósito Transformador: Fazer parte de histórias reais de transformação na vida das pessoas • Ambiente Inspirador: Trabalhar com uma equipe apaixonada e comprometida com a excelência • Desenvolvimento Profissional: Oportunidade de crescer com uma clínica em expansão • Cultura de Acolhimento: Ambiente que valoriza o bem-estar da equipe e dos pacientes

Construir políticas, normativas, documentos e fluxos operacionais.

Vivemos a rotina de projetos e nossa equipe é multidisciplinar e ágil. Trazemos soluções aos clientes. Oferecemos inovação ao mercado. Somos inquietos por natureza. title: Hardware test & verification designer
description:
At TOPIC ( in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer
with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?
“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”
Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems
What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.
Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:
Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.
What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions
This will make you better:
Permanent contract
An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support
This will keep you healthy:
Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
Regular fun, social, and sports events
What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
Proficient in Python (required); experience with Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ is a plus;
Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.
Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.
Diversity & Inclusion
At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Development (fundraiser) officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning. The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.
Responsibilities:
Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
Between 1 and 3 years of experience.
*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding “Leis de incentivo”

Por meio da lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Atendimento ao cliente (RH e usuário final);
Interface junto a fornecedores em geral (seguráveis e não seguráveis);
Auditoria cadastral em produtos;
Orientações sobre coberturas previstas na ANS;
Suporte e acompanhamento de liberação de cirurgia, procedimento e internação;
Suporte no agendamentos de consultas e exames;
Compra e faturamento de benefícios não seguráveis;
Faturamento de benefício segurável (saúde, vida, dental e previdência);
Baixa de arquivo, conferência e rateio;
Controle de pagamento de fatura;
Acompanhamento e sinalização de maioridade de dependente;
Conferência da base de ativos e identificação de carências indevidas;
Movimentações cadastrais (Inclusões, Alterações, Exclusões);
Saúde e reuniões com operadoras, com os temas pertinentes à Gestão de Saúde.
Requisitos e Qualificações:

Conhecimento em operadoras/seguradoras de Seguro Saúde, Odonto e Vida;
Conhecimento em fornecedores de benefícios não seguráveis e técnicos operacionais;
Conhecimento Intermediário em Excel.

title: Analista sr - suprimentos diretos (inteligência) - corporativo rj
description:

- Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios:
Domínio de Excel (avançado) para análises, controles e construção de indicadores;
Power BI, Power Query, linguagem M, DAX, SQL e Dax Studio;

- Dar suporte às demais células de Compras.
